name: outline
goal: Ship outline.py, per crew/contracts/outline.md: a structural outline of Python and Markdown source text as Entry records, plus render() to print it - without ast and without reading files. Designed by Kimi (special teams, 2026-09-26); unified by Claude: team set from PERSONNEL.md posts (Kimi could not read the roster).

tasks.instructions: Read crew/contracts/outline.md end to end, including the Python rules, Markdown rules and render format, then HOUSE_STYLE.md. Implement outline.py exactly as specified: the frozen Entry dataclass, outline(text, kind) and render(entries). Do not use ast, open, or any import beyond dataclasses, re and __future__.annotations. The traps are spelled out in the numbered rules: keyword-first matching with an indent stack for depth, tab = next multiple of 8, triple-quote state so docstring bodies are invisible, fence toggling for Markdown, closing-hash stripping, and ValueError for any unknown kind (case-sensitive). Follow them literally and trace the contract's Examples section by hand before staging.
tasks.test_instructions: Write pytest tests in test_outline.py, one contract rule per test, named test_rule_*. Use exact expected Entry lists and exact render strings - never 'is not None'. Use pytest.raises for the unknown-kind rules. Cover every numbered rule of crew/contracts/outline.md, including the edge cases (decorators, comments, docstrings, tabs, setext, closing hashes, unclosed fences, 4-space indent, 7 hashes). At least 20 test functions.
